# The Guardian

> > The Guardian is a leading British news organization offering comprehensive journalism, career resources through Guardian Jobs, and historical archives spanning the 20th century.

The Guardian provides news coverage, employment opportunities across the UK with a focus on public sector, media, and graduate positions, and maintains extensive historical archives documenting major events from 1899 to 1999.

## Key Topics

- Guardian Jobs
- UK Employment
- Job Search and Career Portal
- Leicester, Nottingham, London, and East Midlands Region
- Public Sector and Media Jobs
- Remote Work Opportunities
- Graduate and Entry-Level Positions
- Regional Job Markets (Edinburgh, Birmingham, Derby)
- Career Development
- 20th Century Historical Archives
- Guardian Journalism
- Job Sectors and Locations
- CV Submission and Applications
- World News Coverage

## Guardian Jobs - Career Portal

- [Job search | Find your dream job with Guardian Jobs](https://jobs.theguardian.com/?INTCMP=JB2): Guardian Jobs career portal for UK job search and CV submission
- [Find a job - Find great jobs on Guardian Jobs](https://jobs.theguardian.com/jobs/?CMP=PPC_JOBS_GGL_): Guardian Jobs listings for public sector, media, and graduate positions

## Optional

- [Guardian Century: how the Guardian saw the 20th century | World news | The Guardian](https://century.theguardian.com/): Guardian archive of 20th century news articles from 1899 to 1999
